ReferenceCards.Name: Cleave
ReferenceCards.Text:
This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). 
*Example: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).*

ReferenceCards.Name: Petition of Stability
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit’s plasma attacks have +6" R.

ReferenceCards.Name: Thirst for Glory
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. This unit has +1 OC.

ReferenceCards.Name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save and, at the end of your
Command phase, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.

ReferenceCards.Name: Gunnery Honours
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. Once per phase, you can re‑roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll
and one Damage roll for the bearer.

ReferenceCards.Name: Firestorm Coordinators
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the
[SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Astartes Tank Ace (Aura)
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. In your Shooting phase, while a friendly Adeptus Astartes
Vehicle unit is within 6" of the bearer, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the
[ASSAULT] ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Thundercowl Turbines
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING FLY unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

ReferenceCards.Name: Bellicose Weapon Spirits
ReferenceCards.Text:
SPEEDER unit only. This unit can re-roll:


▪ Damage rolls.
▪ Rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

ReferenceCards.Name: Raptorial Cogitator Core
ReferenceCards.Text: SPEEDER unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]

ReferenceCards.Name: Artificer Armour
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+ and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Feel No Pain
ReferenceCards.Text: This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Honour Vehement
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is under the effects of the Assault Doctrine, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Adept of the Codex
ReferenceCards.Text: Captain model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, instead of selecting a Combat Doctrine to be active for your army, you can select the Tactical Doctrine. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, that doctrine is active for the bearer’s unit only, even if you have already selected that doctrine to be active for your army this battle.

ReferenceCards.Name: Fire Discipline
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, , you can reroll Advance rolls made for that unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Icon of the Angel
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit is selected to Fall Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

ReferenceCards.Name: Speed of the Primarch
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Rage-Fuelled Warrior
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 3] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Gift of Foresight
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle round, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for the bearer, you can treat the result as a unmodified 6 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Thief of Secrets
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. At the end of the Fight phase, if one or more enemy models were destroyed as a result of a melee attack made by the bearer this phase, until the end of the battle, improve the Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Beacon Angelis
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Osseus Key
ReferenceCards.Text: WATCH MASTER or TECHMARINE model only. At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That model must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll; if that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Tome of Ectoclades
ReferenceCards.Text:
WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle, after you have selected your Oath of Moment target, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select a second enemy unit to be an Oath of Moment target. 


Designer’s Note: *This means that each time a model with the Oath of Moment ability makes an attack that targets either of your Oath of Moment targets, you can re-roll the Hit roll.*

ReferenceCards.Name: Shroud of Heroes
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) When this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining, or its full wounds remaining if this model was battle-shocked when it was destroyed

ReferenceCards.Name: Stubborn Tenacity
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Battle-shocked and below its Starting Strength.

ReferenceCards.Name: Weapons of the First Legion
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Pennant of Remembrance
ReferenceCards.Text:
Ancient model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. While that unit
is Battle-shocked, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Execute and Redeploy
ReferenceCards.Text: Phobos model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit has shot, if that unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to delcare a charge. This cannot allow the bearer's unit to move more than once in your Shooting phase.

ReferenceCards.Name: Ghostweave Cloak
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative Abilities

ReferenceCards.Name: Shadow War Veteran
ReferenceCards.Text: Phobos model only.  Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP

ReferenceCards.Name: The Blade Driven Deep
ReferenceCards.Text: Adpetus Astartes Infantry model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators Ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Feinting Withdrawal
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it fell back

ReferenceCards.Name: Fury of the Storm
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Mounted model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 2 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Portents of Wisdom
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Hunter's Instincts
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Mounted model only. If the bearer's unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as being one higher than it actually is

ReferenceCards.Name: Adept of the Omnissiah
ReferenceCards.Text: Techmarine model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master of the Machine War
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that VEHICLE is eligible to shoot even if it Fell Back or Advanced this turn.

ReferenceCards.Name: Target Augury Web
ReferenceCards.Text: TECHMARINE model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, weapons equipped by that VEHICLE have the [Lethal Hits] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Flesh is Weak
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Adamantine Mantle
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an attack is allocated the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made with a [MELTA] or [TORRENT] weapon, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Champion of Humanity
ReferenceCards.Text: Tacticus model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for them (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

ReferenceCards.Name: Forged in Battle
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, once per turn after making a Hit roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, you can change the result of that roll to an umodified 6.

ReferenceCards.Name: War-tempered Artifice
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

ReferenceCards.Name: Architect of War
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Fleet Commander
ReferenceCards.Text: Captain model only. Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one point on the battlefield and place a marker on that point. At the start of your next Shooting phase, place another marker on the battlefield within 12" of the center of the first marker, then draw a straight line between the center of each of these markers. Roll one D6 for each unit that line passes over or through: on a 3+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Both markers are then removed.

ReferenceCards.Name: Indomitable Fury
ReferenceCards.Text: Gravis Model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll on D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+ set the bearer back on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Stoic Defender
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability while they are within an objective you control and, while that unit is Battle-shocked, halve the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit instead of changing it to 0

ReferenceCards.Name: Fear Made Manifest [Aura]
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-Shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by it's controlling player.) Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-Shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Iron Resolve
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Once per battle, after the bearer's unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Rites of War
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer's unit as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Imperium's Sword
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer's unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master-crafted Weapon
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the Precision ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Mounted Strategist
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. You can re‑roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master of Manoeuvre
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. If the bearer's unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, its points value does not count towards the combined points limit for units from your army that are in Strategic Reserve, and for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

ReferenceCards.Name: Recon Hunter
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Eye of the Unseen
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Champion of the Deathwing
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if it is within range of your Vowed objective marker, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lethal Hits
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
*Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

ReferenceCards.Name: Singular Will
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Each time the bearer's unit Pile In or Consolidates, models in that unit can move an additional 3".

ReferenceCards.Name: Deathwing Assault
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer's unit can set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcement step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Cleave
ReferenceCards.Text:
This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). 
*Example: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).*

ReferenceCards.Name: Lethal Hits
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
*Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

ReferenceCards.Name: Coordinated Exploitation

ReferenceCards.Name: Sustained Hits
ReferenceCards.Text:
This ability always takes the form [SUSTAINED HITS X]. Each time an attack made with a [SUSTAINED HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by X.
*Example: An attack made with a [SUSTAINED HITS 2] weapon results in a critical hit. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the critical hit, and twice more from the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability).*

ReferenceCards.Name: Devastating Wounds
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time an attack made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon results in a critical wound, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the D characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
Mortal wounds inflicted by [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each critical wound; any remaining mortal wounds inflicted by that attack are lost. 
*Example: An attack made with a [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon with a D characteristic of 3 results in a critical wound against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 mortal wounds. The first 2 mortal wounds are sufficient to destroy 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining mortal wound is lost.*

If they do, until those attacks are resolved, or until that CHARACTER group is destroyed (whichever happens first), that CHARACTER group is the current allocation group.

ReferenceCards.Name: Icon of the Angel
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer’s unit is selected to Fall Back, models in that enemy unit must take Desperate Escape tests as if their unit was Battle-shocked. When doing so, if that enemy unit is also Battle-shocked by other means, subtract 1 from each of those Desperate Escape tests.

ReferenceCards.Name: Speed of the Primarch
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Rage-Fuelled Warrior
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 3] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Gift of Foresight
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle round, just after making a Hit roll, a Wound roll or a saving throw for the bearer, you can treat the result as a unmodified 6 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Thief of Secrets
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. At the end of the Fight phase, if one or more enemy models were destroyed as a result of a melee attack made by the bearer this phase, until the end of the battle, improve the Strength, Damage and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Beacon Angelis
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Osseus Key
ReferenceCards.Text: WATCH MASTER or TECHMARINE model only. At the start of your opponent’s Shooting phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That model must take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll; if that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Tome of Ectoclades
ReferenceCards.Text:
WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle, after you have selected your Oath of Moment target, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select a second enemy unit to be an Oath of Moment target. 


Designer’s Note: *This means that each time a model with the Oath of Moment ability makes an attack that targets either of your Oath of Moment targets, you can re-roll the Hit roll.*

ReferenceCards.Name: Shroud of Heroes
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) When this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6:
▪ On a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining, or its full wounds remaining if this model was battle-shocked when it was destroyed

ReferenceCards.Name: Stubborn Tenacity
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that unit is below its Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that unit is Battle-shocked and below its Starting Strength.

ReferenceCards.Name: Weapons of the First Legion
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Pennant of Remembrance
ReferenceCards.Text:
Ancient model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. While that unit
is Battle-shocked, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Execute and Redeploy
ReferenceCards.Text: Phobos model only. In your Shooting phase, after the bearer's unit has shot, if that unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to delcare a charge. This cannot allow the bearer's unit to move more than once in your Shooting phase.

ReferenceCards.Name: Ghostweave Cloak
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative Abilities

ReferenceCards.Name: Shadow War Veteran
ReferenceCards.Text: Phobos model only.  Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP

ReferenceCards.Name: The Blade Driven Deep
ReferenceCards.Text: Adpetus Astartes Infantry model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Infiltrators Ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Feinting Withdrawal
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it fell back

ReferenceCards.Name: Fury of the Storm
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Mounted model only. Improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 2 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Portents of Wisdom
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Hunter's Instincts
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Mounted model only. If the bearer's unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as being one higher than it actually is

ReferenceCards.Name: Adept of the Omnissiah
ReferenceCards.Text: Techmarine model only. Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for a friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 6" of the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master of the Machine War
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that VEHICLE is eligible to shoot even if it Fell Back or Advanced this turn.

ReferenceCards.Name: Target Augury Web
ReferenceCards.Text: TECHMARINE model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, weapons equipped by that VEHICLE have the [Lethal Hits] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Flesh is Weak
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Adamantine Mantle
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an attack is allocated the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made with a [MELTA] or [TORRENT] weapon, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Champion of Humanity
ReferenceCards.Text: Tacticus model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit can ignore any or all modifiers to their characteristics and/or to any roll or test made for them (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

ReferenceCards.Name: Forged in Battle
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, once per turn after making a Hit roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, you can change the result of that roll to an umodified 6.

ReferenceCards.Name: War-tempered Artifice
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

ReferenceCards.Name: Architect of War
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Fleet Commander
ReferenceCards.Text: Captain model only. Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one point on the battlefield and place a marker on that point. At the start of your next Shooting phase, place another marker on the battlefield within 12" of the center of the first marker, then draw a straight line between the center of each of these markers. Roll one D6 for each unit that line passes over or through: on a 3+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Both markers are then removed.

ReferenceCards.Name: Indomitable Fury
ReferenceCards.Text: Gravis Model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll on D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+ set the bearer back on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Stoic Defender
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability while they are within an objective you control and, while that unit is Battle-shocked, halve the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit instead of changing it to 0

ReferenceCards.Name: Fear Made Manifest [Aura]
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-Shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by it's controlling player.) Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-Shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Iron Resolve
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Once per battle, after the bearer's unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Rites of War
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer's unit as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Imperium's Sword
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer's unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master-crafted Weapon
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the Precision ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Mounted Strategist
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. You can re‑roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master of Manoeuvre
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. If the bearer's unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, its points value does not count towards the combined points limit for units from your army that are in Strategic Reserve, and for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

ReferenceCards.Name: Recon Hunter
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Eye of the Unseen
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Champion of the Deathwing
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if it is within range of your Vowed objective marker, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lethal Hits
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
*Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

ReferenceCards.Name: Singular Will
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Each time the bearer's unit Pile In or Consolidates, models in that unit can move an additional 3".

ReferenceCards.Name: Deathwing Assault
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer's unit can set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcement step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

ReferenceCards.Name: Archangel's Shard
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [ANTI-CHAOS 5+] and [LANCE] abilities.

ReferenceCards.Name: Artisan of War
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer’s weapons by 1, and the bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+.

ReferenceCards.Name: Gleaming Pinions
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6"

ReferenceCards.Name: Visage of Death
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack model only. In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

ReferenceCards.Name: Blood Shard
ReferenceCards.Text: Death Company model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Sanguinius' Grace
ReferenceCards.Text: Death Company model only. Once per battle at the end of the Fight phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models. the bearer can fight one additional time.

ReferenceCards.Name: To Slay the Warmaster
ReferenceCards.Text: Death Company Model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight Phase, if the bearer is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy Character units, you can select one of those Character units and roll six D6: for each 4+, one Character model in that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

ReferenceCards.Name: Vengeful Onslaught
ReferenceCards.Text: Death Company model only. If the bearer is destroyed, until the end of your next turn, each time a friendly Death Company model make an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Calibanite Armaments
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lord of the Hunt
ReferenceCards.Text: Ravenwing model only. The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back and you can re‑roll Desperate Escape tests taken for models in the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Stalwart Champion
ReferenceCards.Text: Captain, Chaplain or Lieutenant model only. While the bearer’s unit is not Battle‑shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Fulgus Magna
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s turn, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Prescience
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only (excluding TERMINATOR models). (Once per turn per unit) In your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if
this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of: 


▪ Up to D6".
▪ Or: If this unit has the Divination Discipline ability, up to 6".

ReferenceCards.Name: Celerity
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only.


▪ When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.


▪ When this unit is selected to make a fall‑back move, if this unit has the Biomancy Discipline ability, that move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

ReferenceCards.Name: Obfuscation
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only.


▪ Enemy units cannot target this unit with snap shooting attacks.
▪ If this unit has the Telepathy Discipline ability, this unit has ‑3" detection range.

ReferenceCards.Name: Fusillade
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have:


▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ If this unit has the Pyromancy Discipline ability, [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

ReferenceCards.Name: Temporal Corridor
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only.
▪ If this unit has the Telekinesis Discipline ability, this unit has Deep Strike.
▪ At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do:
     ▫ Place this unit in strategic reserves.
     ▫ This unit can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn)

ReferenceCards.Name: Benediction of Fury
ReferenceCards.Text: Chaplain model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Adaptable Executioner
ReferenceCards.Text:
EXECRATOR model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this model’s melee attacks have:


▪ [CLEAVE 1].
▪ Or: [PRECISION].

ReferenceCards.Name: A Giant Amongst Giants
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only.


▪ This model has +2 W.
▪ This model’s melee attacks have +1 S

ReferenceCards.Name: Preyslayer
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. This unit can re‑roll advance rolls and countercharge rolls.

ReferenceCards.Name: Prescient Flash
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Troubling Visions
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can use this
Enhancement. When it does, until the start of your next Command phase, all Angelic Legacy abilities
(see left) are active for the bearer’s unit, instead of only two of them.

ReferenceCards.Name: Blazing Icon
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Ordained Sacrifice
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase: on a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was  destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining

ReferenceCards.Name: Deathwing Assault
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

ReferenceCards.Name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll Battle-shock and Leadership tests taken for that unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lord of the Ravenwing
ReferenceCards.Text: Ravenwing model only. You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Ancient Weapons
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by 1.

ReferenceCards.Name: Swift Hunter
ReferenceCards.Text: SPACE WOLVES model only. Model's in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 7" ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Fenrisian Grit
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Feral Rage
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, add an additional 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons.

ReferenceCards.Name: Wolf Master
ReferenceCards.Text: SPACE WOLVES model only. In your Command phase, select one friendly SPACE WOLVES unit within 9" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, teeth and claws and Tyrnak and Fenrir weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Braggart's Steel
ReferenceCards.Text: Space Wolves model only. Add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. If the bearer's unit has achieved one or more Boasts, add 1 to the Damage characteristic as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: Hordeslayer
ReferenceCards.Text: Space Wolves model only. At the start of the Fight phase, if there are more enemy models than friendly models wholly within 6" of the bearer, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. If the bearer's unit has achieved one or more Boasts, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Skjald
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time a SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER unit from your army achieves a Boast, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you gain 1 CP

ReferenceCards.Name: Thunderwolf's Fortitude
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) When this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6:


▪ On a 2+, set up this model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. This model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. This model has 3 wounds remaining

ReferenceCards.Name: Wolf-Touched
ReferenceCards.Text: SPACE WOLVES model only. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of the bearer

ReferenceCards.Name: Hunter's Guile
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three THUNDERWOLF CAVALRY, WULFEN and/or BLOOD CLAWS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves

ReferenceCards.Name: Elder's Guidance
ReferenceCards.Text: SPACE WOLVES model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if the bearer is leading a BLOOD CLAWS unit, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.

ReferenceCards.Name: Helm of the Beastslayer
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time an attack is made by a CHARACTER, MONSTER, or VEHICLE model that targets the bearer's unit, reduce the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

ReferenceCards.Name: Incendiary Animus
ReferenceCards.Text: CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR model only. Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit by 1

ReferenceCards.Name: Oathbound Exemplar
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only. Add 1 to the Advance rolls made for the bearer's unit. If the mission pack you are playing features Actions, the bearer's unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

ReferenceCards.Name: Merciless Denunciation
ReferenceCards.Text: CHAPLAIN or JUDICIAR model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the hit roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Zealous Vanguard
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Consecrating Aura
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Model's in the bearer's unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

ReferenceCards.Name: Imperialis of the Eternal Crusade
ReferenceCards.Text: ANCIENT model only. Each time an enemy unit selects the bearer's unit as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll)

ReferenceCards.Name: Warden of Honour
ReferenceCards.Text: CRUSADE ANCIENT model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time you roll one D6 for the bearer's Vengeful Exhortation ability, add 1 to the result.

ReferenceCards.Name: Orb of the Emperor's Aegis
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Paragon of Fury
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 2 the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time a melee attack made by the bearer is allocated to an enemy model, if the bearer disembarked from a Transport this turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.

ReferenceCards.Name: Battle-Psalm Precentor
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Each time the bearer's unit declares a charge, if an enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test as a result of the Shock and Awe detachment rule, subtract 1 from that Battle-shock test.

ReferenceCards.Name: Augury Servo-Host
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. At the start of your shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

ReferenceCards.Name: Herald of the Sacred Slaughter
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a DEDICATED TRANSPORT, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts 9" ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Adamantine Mantle
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time an attack is allocated the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made with a [MELTA] or [TORRENT] weapon, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: War-tempered Artifice
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Infantry model only. Add 3 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

ReferenceCards.Name: Forged in Battle
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, once per turn after making a Hit roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, you can change the result of that roll to an umodified 6.

ReferenceCards.Name: Immolator
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the attacks characteristics of Torrent weapons equipped by models in the bearer's unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Champion of the Feast
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer's unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Disciple of Rhetoricus
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer's unit as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: Indomitable Champion
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with 3 wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Malodraxian Standard
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Ancient model only. Each time an attack targets the bearer’s unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of the bearer’s unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Blackwing Shroud
ReferenceCards.Text:

Phobos model only. The bearer has the following ability:


Lord of Deceit (Aura): Each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that
unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Umbral Raptor
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

ReferenceCards.Name: Hunter's Instincts
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. In your Movement phase, if the bearer’s unit is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

ReferenceCards.Name: Spiritus Ferrum
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer’s melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: Medusan Roar [Aura]
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 6" of
the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle‑shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by
its controlling player). Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle‑shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Iron Laurel
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer’s unit as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: Steel Font
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, in your Command phase, you can return 1 destroyed Bodyguard model to that unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Spearpoint Paragon

Each time the bearer ends a Charge move, until the end of the turn, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Veteran of Behemoth
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. In addition, while the bearer’s unit is under the effects of the Devastator Doctrine, you can reroll Advance rolls made for that unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Grimnar's Mark
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator Captain model only. Once per battle round, from the second battle round
onwards, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for
0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this turn.


In the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a Wolf Guard Terminators unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Howlmaw
ReferenceCards.Text:
Wolf priest model only. At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 6" of the
bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock, subtracting 1 from the result.

ReferenceCards.Name: Chariots of the Storm
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Adeptus Astartes units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Skjald's Foretelling
ReferenceCards.Text: Wolf Guard Battle Leader model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LANCE] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Carmine Reliquary
ReferenceCards.Text:
Chaplain model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability. Each time you take a
Battle-shock test for an Adeptus Astartes unit within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll the result

ReferenceCards.Name: Master of the Red Thirst

ReferenceCards.Name: Bombast Omnivox
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time you select the bearer’s unit as the target of a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer’s unit has the Battleline keyword: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Laurels of Thunder
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. You can re‑roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit in a turn in which it was set up on the battlefield.

ReferenceCards.Name: Orbital Uplink Reliquary
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Adeptus Astartes units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Veteran of the Vanguard
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Dedicated Gunship
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s Fight
phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer
can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into
Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Seals of Reconquest
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

ReferenceCards.Name: Avenging Avatar (Aura)
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. In the Battle‑shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 9" of the bearer, that enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test.

ReferenceCards.Name: Scroll of Proclamation
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer’s unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Charge roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Liberatum
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if the
target is within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Hit roll and you can re‑roll the Wound roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Honour Indefatigable
ReferenceCards.Text: The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Castellum Omnivox
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Fall Back move, select one of the following to apply to that unit until the end of the turn: 
- That unit is eligible to perform an Action in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
- That unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

ReferenceCards.Name: Spy-skull Datalink

ReferenceCards.Name: Defensive Mastery

ReferenceCards.Name: Liberator
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase,

marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over
that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

ReferenceCards.Name: Shock Deployment
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator or Gravis model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Armoured Commander
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this
Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that Transport on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

PHOBOS model only. This model has:

▪ Stealth.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lone Operative
ReferenceCards.Text:
Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.

▪ Instrument of the God‑Emperor (Once per battle, per army):
   In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, if this unit is engaged with an enemy CHARACTER unit, you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s melee attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

▪ Foreseen Paths of the Unholy: This unit has ‑3" detection range.

▪ Vision of Momentous Brutality: This model’s melee attacks have +2 A.

▪ Augury of Retribution: Melee attacks that target this unit have [HAZARDOUS].

▪ Omen of Sacred Intervention: When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is ‑1 CP.

▪ Harbinger of Judgement: When an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this model is selected to make a fall‑back move, roll one D6:
    ▫ On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

ReferenceCards.Name: Cleave
ReferenceCards.Text:
This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). 
*Example: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).*

ReferenceCards.Name: The Tome of Ectoclades
ReferenceCards.Text:
WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle, after you have selected your Oath of Moment target, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select a second enemy unit to be an Oath of Moment target. 


Designer’s Note: *This means that each time a model with the Oath of Moment ability makes an attack that targets either of your Oath of Moment targets, you can re-roll the Hit roll.*

ReferenceCards.Name: Shroud of Heroes
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. (Once per battle, per army) When this model is destroyed, at the end of the phase, roll one D6:

ReferenceCards.Name: Fleet Commander
ReferenceCards.Text: Captain model only. Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one point on the battlefield and place a marker on that point. At the start of your next Shooting phase, place another marker on the battlefield within 12" of the center of the first marker, then draw a straight line between the center of each of these markers. Roll one D6 for each unit that line passes over or through: on a 3+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Both markers are then removed.

ReferenceCards.Name: Indomitable Fury
ReferenceCards.Text: Gravis Model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll on D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+ set the bearer back on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Stoic Defender
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability while they are within an objective you control and, while that unit is Battle-shocked, halve the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit instead of changing it to 0

ReferenceCards.Name: Fear Made Manifest [Aura]
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. While an enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) is within 6" of the bearer, each time that unit fails a Battle-Shock test, one model in that unit is destroyed (chosen by it's controlling player.) Once per battle, when such an enemy unit fails a Battle-Shock test, you can choose for D3 models in that unit to be destroyed in this way instead.

ReferenceCards.Name: Iron Resolve
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Once per battle, after the bearer's unit is selected as the target of one or more attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Rites of War
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Improve the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of all other models in the bearer's unit as well.

ReferenceCards.Name: The Imperium's Sword
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by all other models in the bearer's unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master-crafted Weapon
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the Precision ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Mounted Strategist
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. You can re‑roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Master of Manoeuvre
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. If the bearer's unit starts the battle in Strategic Reserves, its points value does not count towards the combined points limit for units from your army that are in Strategic Reserve, and for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

ReferenceCards.Name: Recon Hunter
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 9" ability.

ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 if the bearer is within range of your Vowed objective marker: on a 5+ you gain 1CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: Champion of the Deathwing
ReferenceCards.Text: Deathwing model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if it is within range of your Vowed objective marker, a Critical Hit is scored on an unmodified Hit roll of 5+.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lethal Hits
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time an attack made with a [LETHAL HITS] weapon results in a critical hit, you can choose for that attack to automatically wound the target. 
*Designer’s Note: Choosing to automatically wound the target means that no wound roll is made for that attack. You may decide against this, as it means that attack cannot result in a critical wound and so cannot trigger other abilities such as [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].*

ReferenceCards.Name: Archangel's Shard

ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only.

ReferenceCards.Name: Laurels of Thunder
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. You can re‑roll Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit in a turn in which it was set up on the battlefield.

ReferenceCards.Name: Orbital Uplink Reliquary
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Adeptus Astartes units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Veteran of the Vanguard
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Dedicated Gunship
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. Once per battle, at the end of your opponent’s Fight
phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer
can use this Enhancement. If it does, remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into
Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Seals of Reconquest
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.

ReferenceCards.Name: Avenging Avatar (Aura)
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. In the Battle‑shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 9" of the bearer, that enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test.

ReferenceCards.Name: Scroll of Proclamation
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer’s unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge are within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Charge roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Liberatum
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets an enemy unit, if the
target is within range of an objective marker, you can re‑roll the Hit roll and you can re‑roll the Wound roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Honour Indefatigable
ReferenceCards.Text: The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

ReferenceCards.Name: Castellum Omnivox
ReferenceCards.Text:
Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Fall Back move, select one of the following to apply to that unit until the end of the turn: 
- That unit is eligible to perform an Action in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
- That unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

ReferenceCards.Name: Spy-skull Datalink
ReferenceCards.Text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Defensive Mastery
ReferenceCards.Text: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three Adeptus Astartes units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

ReferenceCards.Name: Liberator
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase,
and the bearer’s unit (or any Heavy Transport it is embarked within) is within range of that objective
marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over
that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

ReferenceCards.Name: Tip of the Spear
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. If the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Transport, that transport
has the Scouts 6" ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Shock Deployment
ReferenceCards.Text: Adeptus Astartes Terminator or Gravis model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer’s unit is selected to shoot, if it disembarked from a Transport this turn, until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Armoured Commander
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per turn, in your Movement phase, the bearer can use this
Enhancement. If it does, select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport that is in Strategic Reserves. Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up that Transport on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

ReferenceCards.Name: Shroud Field
ReferenceCards.Text:
PHOBOS model only. This model has:


▪ Lone Operative.
▪ Stealth.

ReferenceCards.Name: Lone Operative
ReferenceCards.Text:
Unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within 12" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within 12" of this unit. 
If this ability takes the form Lone Operative X", unless part of an attached unit, this unit is not visible to enemy models unless they are within X" of this unit, and it cannot be targeted by [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons unless the attacking model is within X" of this unit.

ReferenceCards.Name: Stealth
ReferenceCards.Text: If every model in a unit has this ability, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, that unit has the benefit of cover against that attack (13.08).

ReferenceCards.Name: Blood Boil
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only. This model’s [PSYCHIC] attacks:


▪ Have [ANTI: non‑MONSTER/VEHICLE 5+].
▪ Can re‑roll damage rolls.

ReferenceCards.Name: Aureole of the Angel
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit has ‑3" detection range

ReferenceCards.Name: Angelic Executioner
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. When this unit is selected to fight, this unit’s melee attacks have:


▪ [LETHAL HITS].
▪ Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

ReferenceCards.Name: Shadow of Abomination
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only. (Once per battle, per army) When this unit is selected to fight you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s melee attacks have +1 D.

ReferenceCards.Name: Instinctive Interception
ReferenceCards.Text: DEATH COMPANY model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is ‑1 CP.

ReferenceCards.Name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
ReferenceCards.Text: DEATH COMPANY model only. This model’s melee attacks have +2 A

ReferenceCards.Name: Limitless Zeal
ReferenceCards.Text: CHAPLAIN model only. This unit has +1 to charge rolls

ReferenceCards.Name: Inescapable Interrogation
ReferenceCards.Text: CHAPLAIN model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

ReferenceCards.Name: Guiding Omens
ReferenceCards.Text:
EMPEROR’S CHAMPION model only. At the start of the first battle round, you can select up to three of the following abilities. This model has those abilities until the end of the battle:

▪ Instrument of the God‑Emperor (Once per battle, per army):
   In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, if this unit is engaged with an enemy CHARACTER unit, you can use this ability. If you do, this model’s melee attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

▪ Foreseen Paths of the Unholy: This unit has ‑3" detection range.

▪ Vision of Momentous Brutality: This model’s melee attacks have +2 A.

▪ Augury of Retribution: Melee attacks that target this unit have [HAZARDOUS].

▪ Omen of Sacred Intervention: When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is ‑1 CP.

▪ Harbinger of Judgement: When an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) engaged with this model is selected to make a fall‑back move, roll one D6:
    ▫ On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

ReferenceCards.Name: Avenging Angel
ReferenceCards.Text:
ADEPTUS ASTARTES FLY INFANTRY model only. When this unit ends an ingress move, select up to one enemy unit within 9" of this unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that
battle-shock roll.

ReferenceCards.Name: Cleave
ReferenceCards.Text:
This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). 
*Example: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).*

ReferenceCards.Name: Petition of Stability
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit only. This unit’s plasma attacks have +6" R.

ReferenceCards.Name: Thirst for Glory
ReferenceCards.Text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES TERMINATOR model only. This unit has +1 OC.

ReferenceCards.Name: Redoubtable Machine Spirit
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save and, at the end of your
Command phase, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.

ReferenceCards.Name: Gunnery Honours
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. Once per phase, you can re‑roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll
and one Damage roll for the bearer.

ReferenceCards.Name: Firestorm Coordinators
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the
[SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

ReferenceCards.Name: Astartes Tank Ace (Aura)
ReferenceCards.Text:
Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model only. In your Shooting phase, while a friendly Adeptus Astartes
Vehicle unit is within 6" of the bearer, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the
[ASSAULT] ability

ReferenceCards.Name: Thundercowl Turbines
ReferenceCards.Text: RAVENWING FLY unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

ReferenceCards.Name: Bellicose Weapon Spirits
ReferenceCards.Text:
SPEEDER unit only. This unit can re-roll:


▪ Damage rolls.
▪ Rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

ReferenceCards.Name: Raptorial Cogitator Core
ReferenceCards.Text: SPEEDER unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER]

ReferenceCards.Name: Sanctified in Slaughter
ReferenceCards.Text: This unit has +1OC.

ReferenceCards.Name: Gore-stained Veterans
ReferenceCards.Text: This unit’s melee attacks have +1 WS.

ReferenceCards.Name: Talons of Butchery
ReferenceCards.Text: This unit’s Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].

ReferenceCards.Name: Cleave
ReferenceCards.Text:
This ability always takes the form [CLEAVE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [CLEAVE] weapon, if you only selected one target for all of that weapon’s attacks, add X additional attack dice for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). 
*Example: If a [CLEAVE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 3 targets one unit containing 16 models, you would gather three additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of six for that weapon).*

ReferenceCards.Name: Murder-forged Entity
ReferenceCards.Text: This unit has DAEMON.

ReferenceCards.Name: Terror of Khorne
ReferenceCards.Text: At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit engaged with this unit. That enemy unit makes a battle‑shock roll, with -1 to that battle‑shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.
